duelcraft.collection.sort_deck_help: Normal Monsters → Effect Monsters → Spells → Traps. Sorts each section separately, preserving order within each type.
duelcraft.configuration.title: Duelcraft Configs
duelcraft.collection.title: Collection and deck editor
duelcraft.collection.unavailable: Card transfers are not available yet.
duelcraft.collection.error_stale: The collection changed. Refresh and try again.
duelcraft.collection.error_busy: Collection changes are locked while preparing or playing a duel.
duelcraft.collection.error_ineligible: This list does not meet the supported activation checks%s
duelcraft.collection.error_not_found: This saved list no longer exists.
duelcraft.collection.error_data_unavaila: Collection data is unavailable. Ask the server administrator to check it.
duelcraft.collection.error_invalid: Check the list name and the 512-card editor limit.
duelcraft.collection.save_first: Save your changes first, then activate the acknowledged saved list.
duelcraft.collection.supported_checks_re: Activation requires deposited copies across Main, Extra and Side and checks section sizes, three copies per passcode, known cards and placement. The server may apply additional restrictions.
duelcraft.collection.supported_checks_op: Activation does not require deposited copies. Section sizes, three copies per passcode, known cards and placement still apply, and the server may apply additional restrictions.
duelcraft.collection.ownership_required_: This server requires enough deposited copies. Other server restrictions may also apply.
duelcraft.collection.ownership_optional_: This server allows missing deposited copies. Other server restrictions may still apply.
duelcraft.collection.delete_copy: The saved list and its current edits will be removed. Cards in your collection are kept.
duelcraft.collection.save_changes_copy: Save waits for acknowledgement. Discard continues without these edits. Cancel keeps editing.
duelcraft.collection.saving: Saving… Your draft is retained until acknowledgement.
duelcraft.collection.saved: List saved. Missing copies remain marked.
duelcraft.collection.saved_active_cleare: List saved; active selection cleared. Fix the activation problems in Details.
duelcraft.collection.active_cleared: A previous active list was cleared by current server policy. Review Details.
duelcraft.collection.eligibility_rejecte: Activation rejected. Fix these problems in the saved list, then save and try again.
duelcraft.collection.missing_copies: Passcode %1$s: missing %2$s deposited copies across Main, Extra and Side.
duelcraft.collection.more_problems: Additional problems were omitted. Fix the listed problems, save and try Activate again.
duelcraft.collection.issue.main_size: Main has %2$s cards; the supported size is 40–60 (boundary %3$s).
duelcraft.collection.issue.extra_size: Extra has %2$s cards; remove cards until it has at most %3$s.
duelcraft.collection.issue.side_size: Side has %2$s cards; remove cards until it has at most %3$s.
duelcraft.collection.issue.copies: Passcode %1$s: %2$s copies in the list; the supported maximum is %3$s across all sections.
duelcraft.collection.issue.unknown: Passcode %1$s: unknown card. Remove it or ask the server administrator to check the card data.
duelcraft.collection.issue.unplayable: Passcode %1$s: this card cannot be played in a list (tokens are not allowed). Remove it.
duelcraft.collection.issue.main_placemen: Passcode %1$s: Fusion, Synchro, Xyz and Link cards belong in Extra, not Main. Move this card to Extra.
duelcraft.collection.issue.extra_placeme: Passcode %1$s: this card does not belong in Extra. Move it to Main or Side.
duelcraft.collection.operation_failed: Operation failed: %s. Your draft is retained. Refresh and retry if the collection changed.
duelcraft.collection.refresh_failed: Collection refresh failed: %s. Your draft and any acknowledged Save are retained. Use Refresh to try again.
duelcraft.collection.catalog_loading: Loading card catalog… Saved passcodes can still be inspected.
duelcraft.collection.catalog_failed: Card catalog unavailable. Saved passcodes can still be removed and saved.
duelcraft.collection.no_matches: No matching cards. Open Filters to clear.
duelcraft.collection.unknown_card: Metadata unavailable. This passcode can be removed from the list and saved; adding it requires catalog metadata.
